reading.ru: Спаси меня, Боже, потому что воды поднялись до шеи моей
reading.question: What is the first plea in this psalm?
options: Rejoice and sing to the Lord
Be merciful to me
Save me because the waters have risen to my neck
Punish my enemies severely
reading.correct: Save me because the waters have risen to my neck
reading.explain: The opening lines are 'Спаси меня, Боже' (Save me, God) and 'воды поднялись до шеи моей' (waters have risen to my neck)

reading.ru: Я погряз в глубоком иле и нет опоры
reading.question: What is the speaker's physical and spiritual condition?
options: Prosperous and secure on solid ground
Sunk in deep mire with no support
Strong and mighty like a rock
Rich and blessed with abundance
reading.correct: Sunk in deep mire with no support
reading.explain: The text says 'я погряз в глубоком иле и нет опоры' (I sank in deep mire and there is no support)

reading.ru: Ненавидящих меня без всякой причины стало больше, чем волос на моей голове
reading.question: What does the psalmist say about his enemies?
options: They are few and hesitant
They outnumber the hairs on his head and hate him without cause
They are few but very strong
They seek his good and peace
reading.correct: They outnumber the hairs on his head and hate him without cause
reading.explain: The text says 'Ненавидящих меня без всякой причины стало больше, чем волос на моей голове' (Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs on my head)

reading.ru: Боже, Ты знаешь мое безрассудство, и грехи мои от Тебя не сокрыты
reading.question: What does the speaker acknowledge about God's knowledge?
options: God is ignorant of human affairs
God knows his foolishness and his sins cannot be hidden from Him
God approves of all his actions
God does not concern Himself with human sin
reading.correct: God knows his foolishness and his sins cannot be hidden from Him
reading.explain: The text explicitly says 'Ты знаешь мое безрассудство, и грехи мои от Тебя не сокрыты' (You know my foolishness, and my sins are not hidden from You)

reading.ru: Ведь ради тебя сношу я упреки, и позор покрыл мое лицо
reading.question: Why does the speaker suffer reproach and shame?
options: Because he is wicked and deserves it
Because of his devotion to God, he bears reproach and shame
Because he is weak and cowardly
Because he has become proud and arrogant
reading.correct: Because of his devotion to God, he bears reproach and shame
reading.explain: The text says 'ради тебя сношу я упреки' (for Your sake I bear reproach)

reading.ru: Это будет приятней Господу, нежели вол, нежели молодой бык с рогами и копытами
reading.question: What is more pleasing to God than animal sacrifices?
options: Silence and meditation in the temple
Praise and thanksgiving from a broken spirit
Building grander altars
Making solemn vows to God
reading.correct: Praise and thanksgiving from a broken spirit
reading.explain: The context before this verse shows the speaker will 'хвалить имя Бога в песне' (praise God's name in song) and this will be 'приятней Господу' (more pleasing to the Lord) than sacrifices
